dct_description_sm: SmartICE Pond Inlet is in support of developing improved ice forecast services and sea ice information for the Community of Pond Inlet, Nunavut through a partnership between university, community and government. It builds on the SmartICE project that began in northern Labrador as a sea ice monitoring system for coastal communities. This project will use in situ and mobile sea-ice thickness sensors deployed in regions adjacent to Pond Inlet specified by community members as significant travel routes and where the ice is known to be hazardous. The data collected by the sensors and validated by community-monitored sea ice thickness stations will be transmitted daily and available to the community through a SmartICE data portal. The data portal will provide maps of ice thickness, ice type, where ships have broken the ice (if applicable) and the floe edge, which will be used by the community to formulate safer and better informed travel routes. The community of Pond Inlet will be involved in all aspects of this project through Ikaarvik and the Mittimatalik Hunters and Trappers Organization (HTO).
